title: 第15章 再比第16章 你把你媳妇落下了
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
却一次，两次的，都没有护住她，他六岁那年就想过，如果他强大一点，再强大一点，是不是就不会和宁苒苒分开，有足够的能力保护宁苒苒？
所以这六年来，唐三无时无刻不在想，无时无刻不在修炼，只要他再努力一点，再强一点，下次见面，他就可以有能力护住宁苒苒了！
可是……宁苒苒受伤吐血的场景再次浮现在唐三眼前，眼底深沉冰凉，现实却狠狠的扇了他一耳光，不，不够，他还不够强，面对真正的强者他根本没有还手之力！
如果对方不是史莱克学院的老师，恐怕刚刚他们没有一个可以活！
唐三的双手已经渐渐变成了白色，莹白如玉。
十指之间，似乎有着淡淡的气流流转。
头微低着，令对手看不到自己已经完全变成了紫色的双眼。
与此同时，赵无极也感觉到了唐三身上的气息变化，明明唐三的魂力没有增强，却令魂圣级别的他感到了几分危险。
赵无极运用起第一魂技，大踏步抬拳直冲唐三面门。
“赵老师，小心了。”
唐三突然猛的抬起头，眼眸中紫光骤然强盛起来，看到他那紫色的双眸，赵无极顿时被吓了一跳，脚下步伐也缓了一缓。
唐三下垂的双手在腰间两旁飘然抬起。
嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤嗤......，十道寒光在唐三双手十指轻捻之中进发而出，分别射向赵无极双眼、双肩、咽喉、心脏，双膝，下体和小腹。
十道寒光的攻击位置竟然没有一处是相同的，而且选的全是要害。
这是什么东西？赵无极吓了一跳，然而以他的能力根本躲不开，赵无极本身就是力量和防御型的魂师，敏捷这一块正是他的短板。
低吼一声，催动不动冥王身来抵挡，与此同时，唐三运用鬼影迷踪飞速后退，十声爆鸣同时响起，但在赵无极强烈的金光中全被反弹了回来。
唐三眼中寒光一闪，手中快速结印，手法快得只能看见光影，各类暗器如漫天飞雨飞向赵无极，五花八门，这诡异的手法令赵无极防不胜防。
赵无极自以为摸清唐三的套路，全身裹着不动冥王身的金光冲向唐三。
面对赵无极的大力金刚掌唐三丝毫不见慌乱。
脚下不断后退，蓝银草悄然缠上赵无极的两脚，拦住了他的速度，又节省自己的内力。

凭着蓝银草和鬼影迷踪，唐三纵然实力不如赵无极，但赵无极也奈何不了他。
大力金刚掌几次落空。
宁苒苒看得眼睛亮晶晶的，不愧是唐三，好厉害啊！
唐三之所以要一个人对战赵无极，一来是怕暗器误伤其他人，二来自己一个人躲闪的空间也更大。
围观的众人暗暗吃惊，他们发现如果跟唐三对战的是自己的话，不出三招就已经中招了。
宁荣荣：“他……简直不可思议！
唐三真的跟我们一样只有十二岁吗？”
宁苒苒笑笑：“姐姐现在知道三哥的厉害了吧！”
“是是是，你家三哥最厉害！”
……
小舞握了握手心，愣愣的看着唐三的暗器跟不要钱一样一个劲的往外掏，那些暗器唐三平常很宝贵，都是他这六年一点一滴慢慢收集的，但是现在……
小舞转头看了下那边正跟宁荣荣说笑的宁苒苒，是因为……她吗？因为赵老师打伤了宁苒苒，所以小三你才会这么生气吗？小舞心里这么想着，有些失落。
最后，唐三凭借弩箭与昊天锤成功打伤赵无极，但也就拼了个两败俱伤。
唐三在半空中落下，吐了好大一口血，幸好有戴沐白接住了他。
伴随着那柱香燃尽，很显然，唐三赢了！
content_en:
But he failed to protect her once and twice. When he was six years old, he had thought that if he was stronger and stronger, wouldn't he be separated from Ning Ranran and have enough ability to protect Ning Ranran?
So in the past six years, Tang San has been thinking and practicing all the time. As long as he works harder and is stronger, he will be able to protect Ning Ranran next time they meet!
But... the scene of Ning Ranran being injured and vomiting blood appeared in front of Tang San's eyes again, his eyes were deep and cold, but reality slapped him hard, no, not enough, he was not strong enough, and he had no power to fight back against the truly strong!
If the other party wasn't a teacher from Shrek Academy, I'm afraid none of them would have survived just now!
Tang San's hands had gradually turned white, as white as jade.
There seemed to be a faint flow of air flowing between the ten fingers.
He lowered his head slightly so that his opponent could not see his eyes that had completely turned purple.
At the same time, Zhao Wuji also felt the change in Tang San's aura. It was obvious that Tang San's soul power had not increased, but it made him at the Soul Saint level feel a bit dangerous.
Zhao Wuji used his first soul skill, strode forward and raised his fist towards Tang San's door.
"Teacher Zhao, be careful."
Tang San suddenly raised his head, and the purple light in his eyes suddenly became stronger. Seeing his purple eyes, Zhao Wuji was immediately startled, and his steps slowed down.
Tang San's drooping hands floated up on both sides of his waist.
Chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi chi.
The attack positions of the ten cold rays were not the same, and they were all chosen at the key points.
What is this? Zhao Wuji was startled, but with his ability, he couldn't dodge at all. Zhao Wuji himself was a powerful and defensive soul master, and his agility was his shortcoming.
With a low roar, he urged Pluto to move his body to resist. At the same time, Tang San used the ghost shadow to retreat quickly. Ten explosions sounded at the same time, but they were all bounced back by Zhao Wuji's strong golden light.
A cold light flashed in Tang San's eyes, and he quickly formed seals in his hands. The technique was so fast that only light and shadow could be seen. All kinds of hidden weapons flew towards Zhao Wuji like rain, and they were of all kinds. This weird technique made Zhao Wuji unable to guard against it.
Zhao Wuji thought he had figured out Tang San's tactics, so he rushed towards Tang San, wrapped in the golden light of the Immovable Pluto's body.
Facing Zhao Wuji's powerful Vajra Palm, Tang San showed no signs of panic.
His feet kept retreating, and the blue silver grass quietly wrapped around Zhao Wuji's feet, stopping his speed and conserving his own internal energy.
With the help of Blue Silver Grass and Ghost Shadow, even though Tang San was not as powerful as Zhao Wuji, Zhao Wuji couldn't do anything to him.
The powerful Vajra Palm failed several times.
Ning Ranran's eyes sparkled when she saw it, he was indeed Tang San, so awesome!
The reason why Tang San wanted to fight Zhao Wuji alone was that he was afraid of accidentally injuring others with hidden weapons, and also because he had more room to dodge alone.
The onlookers were secretly surprised. They discovered that if they were fighting against Tang San, they would have been hit within three moves.
Ning Rongrong: "He... is simply incredible!
Is Tang San really only twelve years old like us? "
Ning Ranran smiled: "Sister, now you know how powerful Third Brother is!"
"Yes, yes, your third brother is the most powerful!"
…
Xiao Wu shook her hand and watched blankly as Tang San took out the hidden weapons as if they were free of money. Those hidden weapons were usually very precious to Tang San, and he had collected them bit by bit over the past six years, but now...
Xiao Wu turned around and looked at Ning Ranran who was joking with Ning Rongrong over there. Was it because of... her? Because Teacher Zhao injured Ning Ranran, is that why you are so angry, mistress? Xiao Wu thought this and felt a little disappointed.
In the end, Tang San relied on crossbow arrows to fight HaoThe Sky Hammer succeeded in injuring Zhao Wuji, but it ended in a lose-lose battle.
Tang San fell in mid-air and vomited a large mouthful of blood. Fortunately, Dai Mubai caught him.
As the incense stick burned out, it was obvious that Tang San had won!
